crossed_barrel.title: Crossed Barrel additive-manufacturing mechanical-design grid
crossed_barrel.duplicate_policy: mean-toughness-per-identical-design; retain three-replicate count and sample standard deviation

crossed_barrel.threshold_policy: per-column-count empirical 80th percentile using the higher observed setting; development-regression target, not an engineering specification

method.claim_boundary: Passing supports only a reduction in experiment queries on these frozen public offline benchmarks. It does not prove savings in another factory, material, machine, or process.
method.development_disclosure: The target-aware optimizer policy, datasets, targets, and v2 decision structure were selected during development on public data. This protocol and its reference result are development-stage reproducible comparative evidence, not preregistered blind external validation.
